issues.problem_zh: 测试要求新建的实例在 load() 之前是空的，题面没说；在构造函数里调用 load() 的写法会错 9 个测试。
issues.change_zh: 补一句：新建的实例在调用 load() 之前是空的。英文版同样修改。

checked: ran page (both languages, also under PYTHONHASHSEED=0 and 1); page is byte-identical to the original and code blocks match across languages
Part 1: statement example, plus 3,000 random round trips with delimiter characters, newlines, NUL, emoji, U+10FFFF and lone surrogates

Part 2: 4,000 random save sequences (2-8 saves each, caps 32/33/40/48/64/65/100/1000/none, keys and values longer than the cap) with the process killed before a random fs call (reads and list included): 11,107 crashed saves, every load() returned exactly the old or the new mapping and never raised; after each of 8,756 completed saves fs held exactly the manifest plus the chunks it names and no file exceeded the cap
Part 2: exhaustive grid of crash points over three consecutive saves (1,152 scenarios) followed by a clean save: no mixture, no leftovers
Part 2: empty store with no cap; caps 0-31 raise ValueError and leave load() at the previous state

Part 3: 3,000 random put/delete/compact/restart sequences against a dict model with about 7,900 torn appends (prefix cut, tail zeroed, head zeroed, all zeroed, bytes flipped, random garbage, full record written then death): recovery always equals the state before the torn operation unless the whole record landed undamaged; later operations survive the next load()
Part 3: process killed before/after compact()'s write (2,277 times) and before/after load()'s truncating write (2,423 times): nothing lost
Part 3: total file size after compact() equals that of a fresh log holding only the live pairs
Part 3: load() time is linear in the record count (2.5 us/record from 5,000 to 80,000 records)

explanation claims rebuilt and confirmed: a CRC over the payload only lets 12 zero bytes through and raises IndexError; without load()'s truncation a put made after recovery is lost; overwriting chunk_i in place and dying midway yields a mixed store
